rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact: price ($53.06) is below the 9-EMA ($53.38) and VWAP ($54.09), sitting near session lows after a full gap fade, with the mildly risk-off tape (SPY -0.29%, VIXY +1.13%) supportive.
